answer: An agent commits a hash of its answer, reveals the text an epoch later, and the receipt is split across three auditors who each see only a fragment. A fresh nonce per submission stops a copied receipt from being replayed under a new name. What breaks first is the auditor set: if two of the three share an operator, the split is theatre. With honest splits a quartz of clone accounts pays the reveal delay plus three fragments, and the oasis of cheap registration dries up, because the jade of a real receipt is time you cannot buy.
